measurement_definition: Straight-line distance from the center of the webcam lens to the midpoint between the participant's eyes while looking toward the camera.

collection_requirements.participant_instruction: Keep the eye midpoint inside the central guide, keep the eye line horizontal and look toward the camera during measurement.

calibration.feature_definition: 1 divided by Euclidean eye-center separation in pixels normalized by frame width.
calibration.fit_definition: Least-squares linear regression constrained to a positive slope over all valid calibration samples.
calibration.inference_definition: distance_cm = slope*x + intercept, where x = 1 / eye_separation_normalized.
